Samsung TV Plus IN.notes: Samsung TV Plus IN is pre-installed on Samsung Smart TVs in India (~100+ free live channels).

Xiaomi PatchWall.notes: Xiaomi PatchWall aggregates 30+ free & paid OTT apps on Mi Smart TVs in India.

LG Channels IN.notes: LG Channels IN powered by Xumo/Pluto technology embedded in webOS.

fast_landscape_india.nature: Hardware OEM bundled linear streaming channels (Samsung, Xiaomi, LG, TCL).
fast_landscape_india.epg_ingestion: EPG streams use HLS / m3u8 or internal OEM feeds.
fast_landscape_india.feasibility_for_search: 🟡 Moderate - channel metadata can be scraped from OEM web portals, but full VOD depth is limited compared to dedicated AVOD apps.
